format: one JSON file per entity, files[<key>].path: {"cube", "entity", "columns", "rows"}
manifest_hash_method: sha256 of data/opm_manifest.json canonical content: records sorted by (dataset, filename), json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
spec: docs/metric-spec.md (signed; sections 3, 4, 7 KDI-011, 9 M-1, D-040); docs/cube-plan.md Amendment 2 and docs/occupation-spec.md sections 4b, 5, 8 (signed, D-039, D-040)

not_reported.name: Not reported
not_reported.rule: series: occupational_series_code NULL, blank (' ', published as "NO DATA REPORTED") or '*' (INVALID); family: the series is not reported, or occupational_group_code is NULL or blank (a series with no published family). Its own occupation at each level, never dropped or shared out; counts only, no rate (the occupations cube)

occupations.name_rule: each code's published name, latest spelling (the latest month with a non-null name; the employment file before the action files of the same month); families are OPM's published occupational_group_code and occupational_group (D-039), never derived from the series digits

columns.name: headcount

columns.name: hires
columns.description: accession rows effective in the month with this occupation

columns.name: departures
columns.description: separation rows effective in the month with this occupation (transfers out and DRP included)
